candidates.original_title: Haplotypes extending across ACE are associated with Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: ACE haplotypes extending across the gene are associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Both ACE variants (rs4291 and rs1799752) failed to replicate; replication ORs were 0.9 and 0.9, both non-significant.

candidates.original_title: Polymorphism in the BACE gene influences the risk for Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: BACE1 rs638405 (V262V) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk

candidates.original_title: A polymorphism of the brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) is associated with Alzheimer's disease in patients lacking the Apolipoprotein E epsilon4 allele
candidates.description: BDNF C-270T polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk in non-APOE-ε4 carriers

candidates.original_title: Endothelin-converting enzyme-1 is expressed in human cerebral cortex and protects against Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: ECE1 rs213045 (–338 C/A) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk in sporadic late-onset AD
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to sporadic LOAD; OR was 0.9, non-significant.

candidates.original_title: Heparan sulfate proteoglycan 2 polymorphism in Alzheimer's disease and correlation with neuropathology
candidates.description: HSPG2 rs3767140 polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk

candidates.original_title: Insulin degrading enzyme (IDE) genetic variants and risk of Alzheimer's disease: evidence of effect modification by apolipoprotein E (APOE)
candidates.description: IDE rs464954 polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk, with effect modification by APOE-ε4 status
candidates.citation_sentence: When the authors of the original report (Edland et al., 2003) tested the IDE/AD association in cases and controls with an identical APOE-ε4 background, the association was also positive but much less significant in APOE-ε4(−) subjects (association not replicated in the present study, despite a 100% power of replication) and negative in APOE-ε4(+) subjects.
candidates.notes: Replication found a significant association (OR 4.5) in APOE-ε4(+) cases vs APOE-ε4(-) controls, but authors state they cannot plainly conclude to an association; the APOE/IDE interaction was non-significant (p=0.57).

candidates.original_title: Association of early-onset Alzheimer's disease with an interleukin-1alpha gene polymorphism
candidates.description: IL-1a rs1800587 (–889 C/T) polymorphism is associated with early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to sporadic EOAD (<65 yrs); OR was 0.8, non-significant.

candidates.original_title: The 174 G/C polymorphism of the interleukin-6 gene promoter is associated with Alzheimer's disease in an Italian population
candidates.description: IL6 rs1800795 (–174 C/G) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk

candidates.original_title: Interleukin-10 promoter polymorphism in sporadic Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: IL10 rs1800896 (–1082 G/A) polymorphism is associated with sporadic Alzheimer's disease risk

candidates.original_title: Association between tau polymorphism and male early-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: MAPT rs9891103 (IVS11+90G/A) polymorphism is associated with male early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to male EOAD; OR was 1.25, non-significant (p=0.161).

candidates.original_title: The H1c haplotype at the MAPT locus is associated with Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: MAPT H1c haplotype is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.citation_sentence: in the original study (Myers et al., 2005) this SNP did not show any association with AD risk in unstratified single-locus association tests nor is this SNP associated to AD risk after meta-analysis conducted in the AlzGene database
candidates.notes: Replication tested the H1c haplotype in LOAD; OR was 1.1, non-significant. The original SNP rs1467967 was significant in the whole sample but not in the replication.

candidates.original_title: Elevated amyloid beta protein (Abeta42) and late onset Alzheimer's disease are associated with single nucleotide polymorphisms in the urokinase-type plasminogen activator gene
candidates.description: PLAU rs2227564 polymorphism is associated with late-onset Alzheimer's disease risk

candidates.original_title: PRNP Val129 homozygosity increases risk for early-onset Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: PrnP rs1799990 (M129V) polymorphism is associated with early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to EOAD; OR was 1.04, non-significant (p=0.797).

candidates.original_title: Genetic association of the presenilin-1 regulatory region with early-onset Alzheimer's disease in a population-based sample
candidates.description: PSEN1 rs1800839 (–22 C/T) polymorphism is associated with early-onset Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to EOAD; OR was 0.75, non-significant (p=0.181).

candidates.original_title: Is the presenilin-1 E318G missense mutation a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease?
candidates.description: PSEN1 rs362373 (E318G) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication tested in both familial AD (OR 1.8, not significant) and sporadic AD (OR 0.6, not significant); results differ across scenarios, making the overall result inconclusive.

candidates.original_title: The neuronal sortilin-related receptor SORL1 is genetically associated with Alzheimer disease
candidates.description: SORL1 polymorphisms are associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: One SORL1 variant (rs2282649) was slightly significant (p=0.05) but the risk allele was opposite to the original; authors state this cannot strictly be considered a replication. Overall, no replication of SORL1 associations was found.

candidates.original_title: The transcriptional factor LBP-1c/CP2/LSF gene on chromosome 12 is a genetic determinant of Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: TFCP2 rs11550090 polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk (minor allele protective in original)
candidates.citation_sentence: a significant result was also obtained with the TFCP2-rs11550090/AD association but here again, the effect we observed was opposite to the one observed in the original publication: the minor allele being protective in the first study and at risk in our sample
candidates.notes: Replication found a significant effect in the opposite direction from the original (minor allele was protective in the original study but at risk in the replication). Authors explicitly describe the effect as opposite.

candidates.original_title: Analysis of genetic polymorphisms in the transforming growth factor-beta1 gene and the risk of Alzheimer's disease
candidates.description: TGFb1 rs1800469 (–509 C/T) polymorphism is associated with Alzheimer's disease risk
candidates.notes: Replication was restricted to LOAD (≥60 yrs old); OR was 1.1, non-significant (p=0.257).
